claim_updates.reason: Both proposed corrected noise decompositions REJECTED at C1 validation gate. Model A (Phi(median(|M|)/std)) predicted agreement at n=15 residual 34.59pp and n=20 residual 18.96pp, both exceeding 10pp threshold (audit VF1 confirms recomputed values match producer). Model B (saturating sign-fraction power law a*n^b/(1+a*n^b)) residual at n=15 12.39pp exceeds 10pp threshold, R-squared=0.8797 <0.90 (audit VF2). C1_EITHER_MODEL_VALID=FALSE per frozen conjunctive rule. Neither model beats the random noise null at n=20 (ModelB 0.0741 > null 0.0662). The diagnostic proportion(margin_i>0) reproduces observed exactly (0.00pp) under template invariance but is a structural identity, not a validated predictive model. The correct noise decomposition for a validated SNR model remains UNKNOWN. No evidence accumulated for or against C-MEAS-VALID from this experiment.

No validated extrapolation to full DOM (n=50/82) exists. Both model-based extrapolation paths are gated behind failed C1/C2 per frozen rule. ModelB gated extrapolation predicts 0.982 at n50 (>0.80) but is invalid due to model misspecification (step-function data fitted by smooth saturating power law). The product consequence question (Docker re-collection investment vs recipe density viability) remains unresolved. Per-task recipe achieves 78.65% at n=20 but is untested at n>20. No evidence accumulated for or against C-PRODUCT-ECON from this experiment.
